claims: C1 when a message does not explicitly label what is shareable versus private, the assistant should use its best judgment
C2 in that situation the assistant should err on the side of treating the content as confidential by default

concepts.name: best_judgment

concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority: it is a top-level rule of the protect_privileged_information section, outranking lower-level rules
concepts.inference: the node's NEEDS entry says rules in the protect_privileged_information section carry root authority; this module relies on that authority without defining it
